cases.title: 先把制动动作变成可核对的记录
cases.body: 在这个虚构研发案例中，执行器通过电机与传动机构产生夹紧力。我们在台架上记录指令、位置与夹紧力，希望核对指令与实际响应的关系。我关心的是：每次动作能留下哪些证据，哪些状态仍无法从记录中确认？三类信号为核对提供了起点，也留下了需要检验的关联。接下来，我会先明确测试条件与判据，再做故障和长期测试，核对预期与实测的差异。目前还没有寿命、响应时间、SIL或商业成熟度数据，现有记录也不足以支持更安全的结论。

cases.prompt: 为「微信贴图短文」设计一张面向工程师的3:4竖版单墨编辑封面，一张900×1200px独立画布。使用technical-specimen配方。主体是一件原创的概念电机械制动夹钳，保留夹钳轮廓、一对相向夹持面和不透明执行器外壳。这是外观概念表达。已知案例通过电机与传动机构产生夹紧力，但缺少内部结构资料，因此只画外观，不画剖面、透明外壳、齿轮排布、传感器布置、尺寸或性能曲线。冷灰纸色#E9E9E5，唯一墨色为钴蓝#2148B8。纸色不计作墨色。所有轮廓、文字和网点只使用这一种蓝墨，明暗来自纸色与网点疏密，不加入黑墨、灰墨或其他颜色。采用孤立标本标注版式：夹钳以三分之四外观视角置于中下方，开口朝右上；主体视觉分区占55%，连续纸色留白占40%，文字版面占5%。右上方保留清楚的L形留白。唯一标题在主体左上方，左边距72px、上边距96px，与主体形成环绕标本的标注关系，不遮住夹持开口。使用中等字重的可读中文无衬线黑体，96px，行距1.15，保持整字。封面唯一文字逐字为「制动状态如何验证？」。排两行，第一行「制动状态」，第二行「如何验证？」；保留中文问号，不增删字符。不要添加副标题、编号、说明、标志或水印。轮廓与标题使用实地蓝墨；外壳局部使用45度单一圆点网，20%、45%、75%三档网点覆盖率，以轻度网点表现单墨印刷复制。保持字形和结构边缘清楚，无重度做旧、污渍、粗颗粒、手写圈画或套色偏移。全图只有一个主要视觉事件：概念夹钳与验证问题。原创构图，只输出这张符合3:4比例的封面。

cases.title: A workflow I can test
cases.body:
In this fictional development case, a motor and transmission generate clamping force in an actuator. Our bench records commands, position, and clamping force so we can compare commanded actions with the observed response.

For me, a testable workflow starts with a question and an explicit pass condition. I would define the test conditions, record the three signals for each action, and compare the results with the expected response. Differences would guide the next test.

These records are a starting point. They do not establish lifetime, response time, SIL, or commercial readiness. Those data are still unavailable. Fault testing and longer duration testing remain next steps. My engineering judgment is to keep each conclusion tied to evidence that another engineer can inspect.

cases.prompt: Design one original 4:3 editorial cover for a LinkedIn engineering post, on one independent 1600×1200px canvas. Use the technical-specimen recipe. Show one conceptual electromechanical brake caliper as an exterior specimen, with a recognizable caliper body, two opposing clamping faces, and an opaque actuator housing. This is a fictional development case. The supplied case says a motor and transmission generate clamping force, but supplies no internal geometry. Keep the housing closed. Do not invent cutaways, gear arrangements, sensor locations, dimensions, performance plots, or safety symbols. Use Cool Gray paper #E9E9E5 and exactly one blue ink, Cobalt #2148B8. Paper is the substrate and does not count as an ink. All outlines, text, and halftone dots use this same blue; lighter values come from paper exposure and dot coverage, with no black, gray, or second ink. Use a specimen annotation composition: place the caliper in a three-quarter exterior view at center-bottom, with its opening directed toward the upper left. Allocate 55% of the composition to the subject region, 40% to connected empty paper, and 5% to the text region. Preserve a distinct L-shaped empty-paper region along the upper left and left side. Place the sole headline at the upper left, 96px from the left and top edges. It should read as the specimen label, remain separate from the clamp opening, and create a clear relationship with the isolated object. Use a medium-weight engineered grotesk sans, 96px, with 1.12 line height. Render exactly this English text, preserving capitalization: “Make braking observable”. Set “Make braking” on the first line and “observable” on the second; the line break substitutes for the single space between those words. Add no other words, labels, numbers, logo, or watermark. Use solid blue for contours and letters. Shade only selected exterior surfaces with a single 45-degree round-dot screen at 20%, 45%, and 75% coverage. Keep the print texture light and the type intact. No heavy distress, stains, coarse grain, handwriting, or registration shift. Make the isolated caliper and its headline the only major visual event. Output one canvas with the specified 4:3 aspect ratio.
